hypothesis: Calibration representative of corrupted deployment may restore prediction-set coverage by producing more ambiguous answers, without recovering lost classification information.
design: Freeze selected models. Gaussian sigma.8 corruption of observed inputs, clean-input labels.5 fitted seeds x4 tasks x10 independently generated calibration/test cohorts,256 calibration and512 test. Quantum1024-shot grouped measurement both calibration/test; selected classical control too.
cost: 256*1024 calibration shots per fitted quantum predictor in each replicate;10 calibration replicates are research overhead, not a free deployment procedure.
limit: This assumes the corruption distribution is represented in calibration. It does not solve unknown future shifts. Sets containing both labels are explicitly counted as ambiguity.
